---
title: "How a small ceramics studio stopped retyping orders"
date: 2026-10-30
description: "a small studio stopped retyping email orders"
---

Larkspur Ceramics, a small studio, stopped retyping email orders [1]. Purchase orders now reach the order sheet the day they arrive.

## The problem

Every purchase order arrived as an email, and someone retyped each line into the order sheet.

## What changed

Email orders now land in the order sheet without retyping [1]. One paid directory lists support plans for this kind of flow at 300 to 600 a month [2].

"We stopped retyping orders." says Larkspur Ceramics' client owner [3].

## What we would do again

We recommend starting with the orders that already arrive as files.

## Sources

1. Your account of the work, Example Studio, 27 October 2026.
2. [A paid studio directory](https://directory.example.net/automation-studios), directory.example.net, 18 October 2026.
3. The client owner's words, Larkspur Ceramics, 28 October 2026.
